liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mind Left Body Jam** (2 reviews): Garcia's guitar in the jam is not fully articulate, though the reviewer grades the show well; Jam following The Other One is the Mind Left Body Jam, which is mislabelled in the listing [10][16]
- **Truckin'** (1 other source): Truckin' contains a Nobody's Fault But Mine jam; uploader cannot confirm the set break placement [1]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Bobby forgot words in The Other One; reviewer finds the Truckin' through Mind Left Body sequence good but Row Jimmy kills momentum [17]

## Setlist highlights

- **Tico Tico**: rare: 7 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-05-12.150221.sbd.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 175 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: The mix in Promised Land is a mess [1]
- **gd74-05-12.sbd.sacks.2224.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 162 min; rated 3.71/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound and mix very good; Sound is respectable once it settles down, according to the reviewer streaming it; Sound is very good once the speakers stopped flying around [10][13][16][17]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matt.22248.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 162 min; rated 3.29/5 by 7 [3]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matrix-dts.tobin.90179.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 9 songs; 75 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Uploader notes a digital noise flaw at 1:44 in Mississippi Half Step [4]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matrix.tobin.90172.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 9 songs; 75 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Matrix sounds muffled, as if played under a pillow or in a closet [18]

## Around the show

- Strong Washoe zephyr wind blew down from the Sierra at the outdoor show, spinning Wall of Sound speakers overhead, per McNally's book [11]
- Show fell on Mother's Day; wind blew from behind the band toward the crowd, and Phil's bass bombs stood out [12]
- Attendee recalls heavy wind; Garcia said backstage the band played scrappy and wouldn't blame anyone for demanding refunds [13]
- Small crowd, very windy, Wall of Sound swaying; Bobby may have asked for requests, and a plane flew over during the jam [15]
- Reviewer considers it a weak performance for 1974, with strained vocals, forced jams and low energy [9]
- Reviewer calls it solid, with the best jam portion of any show until 5/19 [14]
- Reviewer rates it average against other 1974 and peak-year shows, but better against the band's whole career [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-05-12.150221.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 18, 2020; source: SBD > Reel Master > DAT (44.1k) [1]. Also: Soundboard from reel master to cassette to DAT (shnid 2224), patched with audience CD (shnid 10529) for The Other One and Sugar Magnolia [1]
- **gd74-05-12.sbd.sacks.2224.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Via Darrin Sacks: MSR to cassette to DAT to CDRs to EAC to SHN; previously uncirculated [2]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matt.22248.shnf**: transferred by Matt; source: MSR>C>DAT>CDRs>EAC>SHN [3]. Also: Copy had zero-padding on track ends; uploader clipped them, stitched discs in Cool Edit Pro, and re-cut tracks in October 2003 [3]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matrix-dts.tobin.90179.flac16**: source: DTS Audio 5.1; SBD (shn id 2224) MSR>C>DAT>CDRs>EAC>SHN + AUD (shn id 10529)AUD>?>CDRs>EAC>SHN Shns supplied by Jack Warner - dts mixing by Kevin Tobin [4]. Also: Matrix mixes SBD and audience sources aligned in Audition 3.0, with volume adjusted, then encoded to DTS using Surcode [4]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matrix.tobin.90172.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shn id 2224) MSR> C> DAT> CDRs> EAC> SHN; via Darrin Sacks + AUD (shn id 10529) Partial 2nd Set; AUD>?>CD; via Jack Warner - matrix… [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by SoundCloud: [Ship of Fools (Live at University of Nevada, Reno, NV, 5/12/74)](https://soundcloud.com/gratefuldead/ship-of-fools-live-at) [22]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead University of Nevada - May 12, 1974](https://www.dead.net/show/may-12-1974) [23]
- Photo by Tom Carrigan (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead Wall of Sound University of Nevada Reno 5-12-1974](https://www.flickr.com/photos/151728916@N08/48144262776/) [24]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/151728916@N08/48144262776/) [25]
